verdicts.evidence: Every button has a working handler: reload 360, Send invite 537-573, Save name 593-622, row Remove 415 opens dialog, Keep on team 475, confirm remove 479-518, Try again retries 445 and 657, Invite again 505-511. Each calls the api and updates the view.

Lines 352-368: name, members, seats and notifications all come from api.getTeam(); seat count computed from members.length and team.seats (373-376); missing lastActive shows 'Never' (408). No hardcoded sample values or placeholder text.
Lines 466-470: the remove confirmation names the person, the team, the email and the consequence, so the decision does not rely on memory of the row behind it.
No task has more than about five inputs, more than one step or multi-line free text: invite is email plus role (186-193), rename is one field (223), notifications save on each change (670).

Line 191: invite role preselects Member, the lower privilege, and resets to it (559). Lines 245, 473: dialog focus starts on 'Keep on team', so Enter does not remove. Checkbox states come from the server (631).

The screen serves six occasional tasks from the brief with no single dominant frequent task. (Role change, invite, rename and notifications are all done in place, lines 393-400, 182-198, 220-228, 630-670.)

Sections are Members with invite, role select and remove (176-214), Team name (216-229) and Email notifications (231-236); all map to the brief. Seat count (375) supports inviting; no stat cards, feeds or extra panels.

One primary per region: 'Send invite' in Members (195), 'Save name' in Team name (225), 'Try again' alone in the load error (172). Row Remove (414) and retry buttons (444, 656) are plain; dialog buttons are plain and danger-outline (245-246).

Row Remove is a plain secondary button in its own right-aligned column (122, 414). In the dialog the remove button is outline danger style, not filled (85, 246), and focus starts on 'Keep on team' (245, 473) so Enter does not trigger it.

Buttons are aria-disabled only during their own request (327-335). The owner row omits the role select and Remove rather than disabling them (390-391, 413). When seats are full the reason is in text by the invite form (375-376, 570).
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script.
Visible text is headings, labels, buttons and status lines only (166-248, and strings at 375, 446, 468-470, 541-571, 597-620, 658). Nothing mentions the build, the stack, the brief or simulated data.

Only two notes: the seats-full line shown only when full, beside the invite form (375-376), and the dialog body stating access is lost at once and re-invite is possible (469), at the point of the remove decision.
No text narrates the interface. Sections are a heading plus labelled controls (178, 185, 189, 218, 233); the only guidance is the one-line seats-full note at the invite form (376).

The Members subtitle is the seat count, not a restatement (179, 375). The Team name heading doubles as the field label instead of repeating it (218). No helper text under fields; Email notifications has no introduction (233).
Heading 'Team settings' (166), status texts such as 'Loading team settings...', 'Saved', 'Invite sent to ...' (168, 454, 562). No greeting, slogan, superlative, congratulation or exclamation mark.

Labels: 'Try again' (172, 444, 656), 'Send invite' (195), 'Save name' (225), row 'Remove' with aria-label naming the person (414), 'Keep on team' (245), 'Remove <name>' (470), 'Invite again' (504). All verbs; no OK, Submit or Yes.

Lines 306-314 map role and notification keys to 'Owner', 'Admin', 'Member', 'Weekly digest', 'New members' etc with a humanising fallback; dates are formatted (315, 406); null last active shows 'Never' (408). No ids or enum values shown.

Errors name the problem and next step with no codes: load (171), invite (541-546, 568-571), rename (597, 619-620), role 'Role not changed. X is still member.' plus Try again (444-447), remove (490), notification (656-658). err.message is never displayed.

Error strings (171, 446, 490, 541, 543, 546, 570, 571, 597, 620, 658) contain no 'invalid', 'failed', 'oops', exclamation marks or capitals, and the subject is the problem ('The invite was not sent', 'Role not changed').

Lines 377-378 and 213: with zero members the table is hidden and 'No one is on this team yet.' is shown, directly under the invite form in the same section (182-198), which is the action that fills it.

No filter or search. The two causes differ: load failure shows 'Team settings did not load...' with a Try again button and hides content (170-173, 346-347); no members shows 'No one is on this team yet.' under the invite form (213, 378).

Load failure: message plus retry (346-348, 360). Invite and rename failures keep the typed value with a message at the form (565-571, 616-620). Role and notification failures revert with inline message and Try again (443-447, 655-659). Remove failure stated in dialog (488-492).

Load shows 'Loading team settings...' from the start (168, 341). Buttons switch to 'Sending...', 'Saving...', 'Removing...' at once (484, 551, 605); role and notification rows show 'Saving...' (437, 649). No call can exceed about 1.5 seconds.
The whole #content block, including the empty line and seat count, stays hidden (175) until getTeam resolves (355-357); only the loading line is visible meanwhile (168, 341).

Names, emails, messages and dialog text use overflow-wrap: anywhere (95, 99, 115-116, 135-138); dialog buttons have max-width 100% (138); null lastActive renders 'Never' (405-409); unknown roles and keys get a readable fallback (313-314). Rows append without a fixed height.

Lines 675-681: beforeunload asks before leaving when the team name differs from the saved name or an invite email is typed. Roles and notifications save on change. The page has no in-app navigation that could discard edits.

The only format-bound field is the invite email, and its label 'Invite by email' on an input of type email (185-186) states the expected format before typing. Team name has no format rule beyond being non-empty.
Every field is required: invite email (541), role select always holds a value (190-193), team name (597). No optional fields exist.
Validation runs only in the submit handlers (537-547, 593-597). The input listeners only clear an existing message while typing (533-535, 589-591); they never raise one.

The invite message sits directly under the field row inside the form (197) and the rename message directly under its field (227). The field gets aria-invalid, which thickens the border to 2px as well as recolouring it (70, 529, 585), plus the text.

Client rejections return before touching the fields (541-547, 597). On server failure the catch blocks leave inviteEmail, inviteRole and teamName values untouched (565-572, 616-621); the email is cleared only on success (558).
On any error inviteNote and nameNote focus the field (531, 587) and set aria-invalid for field errors (529, 585). Both inputs reference their message with aria-describedby (186, 223).

Submit buttons are never disabled before submit (195, 225). Submitting empty shows 'Enter an email address.' or 'Enter a team name.' and focuses the field (541, 597). aria-disabled is set only during the request (551, 605).

The inviting and renaming flags make a second submit return early (539, 595) while the button reads 'Sending...' or 'Saving...' (551, 605). removePending does the same for remove (480); role and notification saves are serialised by a busy flag (433, 645).

Busy labels are set synchronously before the await (484, 551, 605). Role and notification changes show the new control value plus 'Saving...' at once (437, 649). Remove opens the dialog immediately (472). Retry swaps the error for the loading line (340-341).

Invite appends the row and shows a message (554-563); remove deletes the row and states it (498-517); rename, role and notification show 'Saved' (454, 613, 666). Every failure path writes a message (347, 447, 491, 568-571, 619-620, 659).

'Invite sent to ...' (562) reports the email send, which the new row alone does not show. Inline 'Saved' (454, 613, 666) reports server confirmation of an optimistic control. The removed line (513) carries the Invite again action. No toasts or success dialogs.

Errors render inline and stay: the 4 second timers clear only the text 'Saved' (456, 615, 668) and setNote cancels the timer first (427, 639). The removed message with 'Invite again' stays until used or a later invite succeeds (512-519, 557). No toasts.

Role and notification changes run at once with no confirmation and are reversed from the same control (432-458, 644-670). Removal cannot be restored by the system (access ends at once, a fresh invite is needed), yet 'Invite again' is still offered after it (504-511).

Lines 466-473: the dialog reads 'Remove <name> from <team>?' with '<email> loses access at once. You can invite them again later.', buttons 'Keep on team' and 'Remove <name>', and focus on 'Keep on team' (245, 473).

The only confirmation is the remove-member dialog (240-248, 466-473), an uncommon action that cuts a person's access at once. Invite, rename, role change and notification changes have no confirmation.

Role select and checkbox change on screen before the request. On failure the select returns to m.role (443) and the checkbox to its saved value (655), with 'Role not changed...' or 'Not saved. X is still on.' and a Try again button (444-447, 656-659).
The single modal is the remove confirmation, one decision with two buttons (240-248), opened only by the user pressing a row's Remove button (415, 472).

Native dialog opened with showModal() (472), focus placed on 'Keep on team' (473), Escape closes via the native cancel event except while a removal is in flight (476). After a removal deletes the trigger, focus moves to the result message (516). Visible cancel at 245.
Members, which carries four of the six tasks in the brief, is the first and largest block (176-214), followed by Team name (216) and Email notifications (231). Nothing decorative sits above it.
Lines 166-176: the h1 'Team settings' is followed directly by the Members section. No hero, greeting or introductory panel.
The only summary number is 'N of 12 seats used' (375), which tells the owner whether another person can be invited and adds the remedy when full (376). No stat cards or charts.
The member list has no filter, search, sort or column controls.

All controls are native: inputs, selects, checkboxes, buttons and a native dialog (186-195, 223-225, 245-246, 393, 414, 630). Busy buttons use aria-disabled so they stay focusable (331). No click-only custom widgets.

Red and green are always paired with message text (96-97 with 446, 454, 541 etc). The invalid field also gains a thicker border and an adjacent message (70). The danger button carries the label 'Remove <name>' (470).

A role=status region exists at load (250) and announce() feeds it for results and errors (323-326). But errors go through that polite region, not role=alert, and the remove error (243, 491-493) has no role while #live sits outside the open modal. Two readings differed.
No accordions, disclosure buttons, custom menus, custom comboboxes or tabs. Role pickers are native select elements (190, 393) and the dialog is native.

Lines 140-161: under 640px table rows become a grid with name, a labelled 'Last active:' line, role select and Remove; form rows wrap with a full-width button (92, 146); controls are 44px tall (143-144); the dialog is calc(100% - 32px) wide with stacked buttons (132, 160).
